author: Inside Edition
description: Seventy-six-year-old Vietnam veteran Mark Eric Young survived five days lost in the Arizona wilderness. He was in town for a wedding and decided to go hiking. He took what he thought was a shortcut and ended up lost for several days. While lost, he was forced to kill a rattlesnake that tried to attack him, and drink his own urine to battle severe dehydration. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Man Kills Rattlesnake, Drinks Own Urine While Lost During Hike
